description:
I used to think any shredder was fine… turns out most of them don’t really protect your info. Once I saw how easy it is to piece documents back together, I stopped using mine.

The micro-cut shredder I use: https://amzn.to/47rWM0N
Disclosure: I may earn a commission if you buy through this link.
